name: sc1_wallx
goal: Scenario 1, WALLX does the manipulation: harness reads the label (QR -> printed ZIP -> demo code), routes it (ZIP3 rule) to a zone and arm (zone 1 = left, zone 2 = right), builds the WALLX prompt from that; WALLX (that arm, other locked, head camera only, 60 calls) picks the bag up and puts it into the zone; harness calls release + home.
setup: Mailer bag on its scenario 1 taped start marks in the middle of the table; arms at rest.
prompt: Use the {arm} arm to pick up the package from the middle of the table, stretch and put it into zone {zone}.
